references.text: In Matthew's parallel account, Jesus tells the officer that it will happen as he has believed, and the servant was healed at that very hour – this confirms the same healing from a distance.
Jesus heals the Canaanite woman's daughter from a distance because of her great faith, just as the officer's servant was healed from a distance.
The royal official's son was healed at the exact moment Jesus spoke the word, even though Jesus was not physically present – a parallel example of healing from a distance.
The context for this healing: the officer's servant was sick and near death, and the officer sent messengers to Jesus – this provides the background for the result in verse 10.
The officer's confession of faith that Jesus only needed to say a word forms the basis for finding the servant well when they returned.
Peter describes how Jesus went about healing all who were under the devil's power – a summary that includes healings like this one.
